Name: Configurable Machine Speed
Author: AditOliSamping
Description:
Ever stared at a keg for 3 in-game days waiting for wine? Yeah, same.
[b]Configurable Machine Speed[/b] lets you set custom processing times for every machine in Stardew Valley. Want your furnace done in 10 minutes instead of 30? Done. Want instant output the second you drop something in? Also done.
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Set custom processing time (in minutes) for every machine individually.[/*]
[*]Instant Output toggle — machine is ready the moment you insert an item.[/*]
[*]Works with Automate — instant output routes to chest just like normal, no weird inventory spam.[/*]
[*]Cask support — set custom days to iridium, or just instant iridium every morning.[/*]
[*]Full GMCM integration — configure everything in-game without touching any files.[/*]
[*]Clean slider UI — steps of 10 minutes, up to 14,000 min (~9.7 days).[/*]
[/list][b]Machines Supported:[/b]
Smelting & Processing Furnace, Heavy Furnace, Charcoal Kiln, Bone Mill, Geode Crusher, Deconstructor, Wood Chipper, Recycling Machine, Bait Maker, Fish Smoker, and many more.
Artisan Machines Keg, Preserves Jar, Cheese Press, Mayonnaise Machine, Loom, Oil Maker, Dehydrator
Incubators Incubator (Coop), Ostrich Incubator, Slime Incubator, Slime Egg Press, and many more.
Other Seed Maker, Crystalarium, Cask.

[b]Compatibility:[/b]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI[/*]
[*]GMCM optional but strongly recommended[/*]
[*]Compatible with Automate[/*]
[/list]
